title: malformed pdl_model_default_parameters
notes: Fixed (spec docs/error-reporting/specs/E-BOUNDARY.md). `validate_pdl_model_defaults` raises `PDLScopeError(PDLException, ValueError)` carrying the path, the pattern and the offending value; `main` names the origin from a membership test on each dict as it is merged, so `--data` is known rather than guessed. The two sibling shapes that produced a bare `AssertionError` (not a list, entry not a mapping) raise the same error. Location stays 1 until phase-3 item 0: the line and column of the value inside the `-d` string need a marks-recording loader, and the record already carries the path, so that upgrade is a rendering change.
